[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Amount: 90
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- Description: Supervision and review of the Agroverse QR label batch remediation for Kirsten's two cacao batches (8oz Nibs Ilheus 187 codes; Ceremonial 200g Paulo AGL8 209 codes). Caught the central defect that Sophia had missed: the delivered qr_highres/ folder was a bare QR code -- 396/396 files pure 2-colour, no tree logo, no farm name, no harvest year, no 'Your tree is getting planted' message, no serial -- while the reference format (IMG_2251 / 2024OSCAR_CT_20260820_96) and the 450x350 qr_labels/ folder both carried full branding. Directing the fix at the asset actually intended for print production, rather than accepting the misleading 'print-ready' label. Also retracted an earlier landing-page concern as correct-by-design, avoiding wasted work. Authored and merged runbook guardrails in agentic_ai_context PR #1671: fixed the stale tokenomics/ path to lineage-assets/scripts/qr_generator/, added SS4a requiring batch_compiler.py for ANY QR image output including one-off high-res exports, and added a branding-presence QC check (grayscale colour-count -- bare QR has 2 colours, a compiled label 10+) to close the gap where batch_compiler.py's --verify checks only decodability, not whether branding survived. Drove four review cycles (REV2 through REV7) with per-turn direction. NOTE: time is an ESTIMATE (~90 min) covering defect review across 4 revision cycles, runbook authoring/merging, and reply/nudge turns -- governor to adjust. Evidence: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1671
- Type: Time (Minutes)
